adult.description: Ask us for help — every message reaches the School of Gaming team. You can also email us at <link>{email}</link>.
adult.thankYou: Thank you — your message is with us, and we’re glad you wrote.
adult.failed: We could not send your message. Please try again.
adult.tooManyRequests: You have sent us several messages already. Please try again a little later.

gamer.description: Stuck on something? Write to us here and we will help.
gamer.replyNote: If we write back, we will email your parent.
gamer.placeholder: What do you need help with?
gamer.thankYou: Thank you — we got your message.

gamer.tooManyRequests: You have sent a few messages already. Try again a little later.
